name: sii-style-teacher-pilot-centered-1gpu
description: SII-style self-teacher pilot on the 300-row multiselect_pilot set, 1 H100: phase A samples 2 Qwen3.5-4B thinking chains (stop at </think>, 1024-token cap) with vLLM; phase B reads SII's answer-slot prompt at the end of each chain (last hidden state -> 255 label logits -> sigmoid per option, averaged over chains) with transformers. No answer parsing. CPU smoke on the base head shows the raw sigmoid q saturates (all 255 label logits are positive), so check q_value_stats/per_chain_softmax and set Q_TRANSFORM=softmax if every q is ~1. Writes runs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot and data/multiselect_pilot/sii_teacher_summary.json. CreateJob dry-run first; this payload is not submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_centered"
REASONING=1 READOUT=1 SHARDS=1 SAMPLES=2 MAX_TOKENS=1024 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 REASONING_BATCH=32 READOUT_BATCH=4 Q_TRANSFORM=centered_sigmoid DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect_pilot" RUN_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_centered" SUMMARY="$R/data/multiselect_pilot/sii_teacher_summary_centered.json" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh > "$R/logs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_centered.log" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
